comment: Data-workflow analysis in Phase 1 — Turns the assessment added by B01.01 into an explicit planning activity and aligns the body with A28.01. This is a targeted strengthening of Phase 1, not a claim that the entire architecture ignores data flows.

public.text: Data-workflow analysis in Phase 1 — Turns the assessment added by B01.01 into an explicit planning activity and aligns the body with A28.01. This is a targeted strengthening of Phase 1, not a claim that the entire architecture ignores data flows.
public.suggestedRevision: Insert bullet: • Analyse existing data workflows and uses alongside the systems inventory: trace priority flows from capture through clinical use, certification, coding and reporting; record the classifications and terminology releases in use, where detail is lost or re-collected, and the reporting obligations each flow serves; and use these findings to specify the required semantic services.
